title: 第5章 执锤的妇人 大明王观想法
slug: 当不成赘婿就只好命格成圣

第5章执锤的妇人大明王观想法
陆景的身世，其实并非庶出那般简单。
倘若只是庶出子弟，他在陆府的境遇，也绝不至于如此的艰难。
十六年前，陆家新近承爵的神霄将军陆神远回乡祭祖，途中因为一桩风月之事，便有了陆景。
可当时的陆神远并不知道这件事情。
陆景生母诞下陆景之后，在九湖府一座小镇中，独自养育陆景八年。
这八年间陆景生母始终甘之如饴，也并不打算让陆景认亲，母子相依为命，便这样过一生她便也知足了。
只是后来，陆景生母却染上了重疾。
她自知命不久矣，于是不得不启程前往太玄京，让陆景认祖归宗。
这其中其实还有许多波折。
比如，当陆景生母领着他跋山涉水两千里之后，出现在十里长宁街。
陆家老太君以及陆家大夫人，都不信陆景是陆神远的血脉。
原因在于陆景眉眼，像极了他那病恹恹却姿容不凡的母亲，却看不出陆神远的影子。
陆神远向来威严如狱，但在这件事情上却只是沉默。
于是陆家老太君、大夫人，就将这对母子拒之门外。
陆景生母并没有央求陆家接纳他们，也没有讨价还价，给陆家缓冲的时间。
心性温柔，绝不愿伤人的她，毅然带着陆景前往太玄京府击鼓鸣冤，状告陆神远舍弃血脉，弃养子嗣。
“我一介画舫女子，自然命贱如畜，死不足惜，神霄将军莫说舍弃了我，就算将我打死，也在法理之中。
可我儿陆景，骨肉里却流淌着九湖陆家的血脉，弃子不养，私德有缺，如何承爵？”
在万千人围观下，陆景生母一手拎着鼓槌，一手牵着陆景，跪在太玄府尹面前，一字一句说出这番话语……

贵胄风流，诞下子嗣，流落他处……这自然是常事。
可闹的太玄京满城风雨的，也便只有九湖陆家的陆神远！
因此，太玄庭中有贵人过问此事，又有汹汹民意激荡于街巷之中。
陆家无奈之下，不得不接母子进府。
于是，八年前有了一桩笑谈，陆景母子也得以进入陆府。
当时年幼的陆景，并不知道母亲为何这般做，稍长了两岁，他还曾怨恨母亲，将事情做的这般绝，让他们在这陆府中受尽冷眼，受尽冷遇。
可是后来，母亲的病越来越重，不久便辞世而去。
陆景这才知道，当初自己的生母，是已料定了自己时日无多，放心不下他，这才抛弃了一切世俗的拘束，鼓起莫大勇气，做出那样的决定……
“朱门里没有饿死的鬼，受人冷眼，总要比裹挟在无端的阴流中，悄无声息的死去要好。”
母亲离世前，突然间不咳了。
她抓着陆景的手，如此对他说道。
这许多记忆，浮现在陆景的脑海里，让此时此刻的陆景，无法遏制的思念那总是温柔注视着他的妇人。
那目光，卑微如青苔，又庄严如大地。
陆景辗转反侧，始终无法入眠，又觉得自己的精神清明无比，索性又拿出大明王神明图。
烛光下，陆景又仔细看了大明王神明图一眼。
旋即将图画铺展在桌子上，闭起眼睛。
思绪开始在脑海里勾勒观想大明王焱天大圣。
黑暗中，一切都那般模糊，
最开始被勾勒出来的，是大明王焱天大圣左手中，举着的那一团光芒。
光芒炽盛、炽热、闪耀。

随着那团光芒越发明显。
陆景明显感觉到，自己并不像上次那样脆弱，血气没有亏空，精神也没有萎靡不振。
同时，陆景只觉得自己身躯底下的皮肉、筋膜、骨骼甚至血液，都受到了奇异力量的炙烤。
让它们越来越热！
一息、两息、三息……
随着陆景越来越专注。
他脑海里突然间闪过一道白光。
一瞬间，陆景便感觉到不那么累了，甚至观想起来也更加专注，更加轻松。
他反应过来：“这白光，大概就是我那一道【勤勉刻苦】的命格了，修行时能让我更加专注，降低疲惫。”
“这白色命格，竟然有如此奇效。”
时间逐渐流逝，陆景身上奇特的感觉也越发浓重。
五息、八息、十息……
一直到约莫十二息时间。
陆景明显感觉到他第一次观想的时候，那种痛苦的感觉有卷土重来的态势。
于是他果断打断观想，缓缓睁开眼睛。
“不可操之过急，上一次观想明显因为观想伤到了自己，如果不是陆景魂灵的滋养，我只怕要休息上十几天才能恢复过来。”
“但有乏力，就停止修行，这样一来，我只需要休息一两个时辰，精神就能够恢复过来，进而继续观想。”
陆景长长吐出一口气。
他只觉得连呼出的气，都是炽热的。
他敏锐的感觉到，自己的气力似乎有所增长，身体也轻盈了许多。

当陆景在微弱的烛光下，看到门槛处几只蚂蚁艰难的拖动着另外一只小虫子的尸体。
他越发感觉到这大明王焱天大圣观想图的奥妙。
“这效果立竿见影。”
陆景深感惊奇，满意颔首：“观想大明王，似乎是在磨练我的精神，打熬我的躯体……”
那命格【勤勉刻苦】也在刚刚的观想修行时，发挥了很大的作用。
“没有【勤勉刻苦】这个命格，我根本无法观赏十二息时间，也许最多撑个八九息，便必须要停下来休息。
看来这命格也十分奇异，也许我以后能够获得更多的命格。”
陆景便在这样的展望中灭去烛火，躺下休息。
入睡前，不知为何，他突然想起他原本的妻子。
“南禾雨……”
剑道天骄南禾雨，师承禹星岛剑道大宗师洛明月，是如今太玄京有数的天之骄子。
她出身显赫，乃是大伏南国公嫡孙，最受南国公宠爱，过往二三年，年老的南国公也多次提出想要召南禾雨回京，成为承爵者。
只是南禾雨心思不在于承爵，多次拒绝。
后来，就有了南国公病重，需要南禾雨成婚冲喜的事。
而陆景就是南禾雨成婚的对象。
只是南禾雨回京后，事情又有了些许变化。
南国公府似乎是反悔了。
“青玥也以为我们能够就此离开满是冷漠的陆府，可惜了，让她失望了。”

Chapter 5: The Woman Holding the Hammer and the Thoughts of the Ming Dynasty King
Lu Jing's life experience is actually not as simple as being born as a commoner.
If he were just a commoner, his situation in the Lu Mansion would never be so difficult.
Sixteen years ago, Lu Shenyuan, the newly enthroned General Shenxiao of the Lu family, returned to his hometown to pay homage to his ancestors. On the way, he met Lu Jing due to an affair.
But Lu Shenyuan didn't know about this at the time.
After Lu Jing's biological mother gave birth to Lu Jing, she raised Lu Jing alone in a small town in Jiuhu Prefecture for eight years.
In the past eight years, Lu Jing's biological mother has always been content with her life, and has no intention of letting Lu Jing recognize her as a relative. Mother and son depend on each other, and she is content to live like this for the rest of her life.
But later, Lu Jing's biological mother contracted a serious illness.
She knew that her fate was not long, so she had to set off for Taixuanjing to let Lu Jing recognize his ancestor and return to his clan.
There are actually many twists and turns in this.
For example, after Lu Jing's mother led him to travel two thousand miles across mountains and rivers, he appeared on Changning Street, which is ten miles away.
Neither the old lady of the Lu family nor the eldest lady of the Lu family believed that Lu Jing was of Lu Shenyuan's bloodline.
The reason was that Lu Jing's features looked very much like his sick but beautiful mother, but there was no trace of Lu Shenyuan.
Lu Shenyuan has always been as majestic as a prison, but he was just silent on this matter.
So the old lady and eldest lady of the Lu family turned away the mother and son.
Lu Jing's biological mother did not beg the Lu family to accept them, nor did she bargain to give the Lu family a buffer of time.
She has a gentle heart and never wants to hurt anyone, so she resolutely takes Lu Jing to Taixuan Jingfu to beat drums and complain, suing Lu Shenyuan for abandoning his bloodline and raising an heir.
"I am a woman who paints a boat, and my life is as low as that of an animal. Death is not a pity. Not to mention that General Shenxiao abandoned me, even if he beat me to death, it is within the law.
But my son Lu Jing has the blood of the Jiuhu Lu family flowing in his flesh and bones. He abandons his son without raising him and has shortcomings in personal ethics. How can he inherit the title? "
With thousands of people watching, Lu Jing's biological mother held a drumstick in one hand and held Lu Jing in the other. She knelt in front of Taixuan Palace Yin and spoke these words word for word...
It is naturally common for nobles to be romantic, give birth to children, and live in other places...
But the only one causing trouble in Taixuanjing was Lu Shenyuan of the Jiuhu Lu family!
Therefore, there were noble people in Taixuan Court asking about this matter, and fierce public opinion was stirring in the streets.
The Lu family had no choice but to take mother and son into the house.
So, there was a joke eight years ago, and Lu Jing's mother and son were able to enter the Lu Mansion.
Lu Jing, who was young at the time, didn't know why his mother did what he did. He was a little two years older, and he once resented his mother for doing things so cruelly that they were treated coldly and coldly in the Lu family.
But later, my mother's illness became more and more serious, and she passed away soon.
Only then did Lu Jing realize that his biological mother had already predicted that he would not have much time left and could not trust him, so she abandoned all worldly restraints and mustered up great courage to make such a decision...
"There are no ghosts who starve to death in the rich family. It is better to be looked down upon by others than to be trapped in the unprovoked undercurrent and die quietly."
Before my mother passed away, she suddenly stopped coughing.
She grabbed Lu Jing's hand and said to him.
These many memories appeared in Lu Jing's mind, making Lu Jing at this moment unable to stop missing the woman who always looked at him tenderly.
That gaze is as humble as moss and as solemn as the earth.
Lu Jing tossed and turned, still unable to sleep, and felt that his spirit was extremely clear, so he simply took out the Ming Dynasty King's Divine Map.
Under the candlelight, Lu Jing took a closer look at the map of the Ming King's gods.
He quickly spread the pictures on the table and closed his eyes.
Thoughts began to outline and visualize the Great Ming King Yantian in my mind.
In the darkness, everything is so blurry,
The first thing that was outlined was the ball of light held in the left hand of the Great Sage Yantian, King of the Ming Dynasty.
The light is blazing, hot and shining.
As the light became more and more obvious.
Lu Jing clearly felt that heHe is not as fragile as last time, his blood is not exhausted, and his spirit is not depressed.
At the same time, Lu Jing felt that the skin, fascia, bones and even blood under his body were being roasted by strange power.
Make them hotter and hotter!
One breath, two breaths, three breaths...
As Lu Jing became more and more focused.
Suddenly a white light flashed in his mind.
In an instant, Lu Jing felt less tired, and even became more focused and relaxed while visualizing.
He reacted: "This white light is probably my fate of [diligence and hard work]. It can make me more focused and reduce fatigue during practice."
"This white destiny has such a miraculous effect."
Time gradually passed, and the strange feeling in Lu Jing's body became stronger and stronger.
Five breaths, eight breaths, ten breaths...
Until about twelve breaths.
Lu Jing clearly felt that the painful feeling he had when he meditated for the first time was coming back.
So he decisively interrupted his visualization and slowly opened his eyes.
"Don't be too hasty. The last time I visualized, I obviously hurt myself because of the visualization. If it weren't for the nourishment of Lu Jing's soul, I'm afraid I would have to rest for more than ten days to recover."
"But if I feel tired, I should stop practicing. In this way, I only need to rest for an hour or two before my spirit can recover and I can continue to meditate."
Lu Jing let out a long breath.
He felt that even the breath he exhaled was hot.
He felt keenly that his strength seemed to have increased and his body became much lighter.
Under the dim candlelight, Lu Jing saw several ants at the threshold struggling to drag the body of another small insect.
He felt more and more the mystery of this visualization diagram of the Great Ming King Yantian.
“The effect was immediate.”
Lu Jing was deeply surprised and nodded with satisfaction: "Visualizing the Great Ming King seems to be tempering my spirit and beating my body..."
The fate of "diligence and hard work" also played a big role in the visualization practice just now.
"Without the destiny of [diligence and hard work], I wouldn't be able to appreciate the twelve-breath time at all. I might last eight or nine breaths at most before I have to stop and rest.
It seems that this destiny is also very strange. Maybe I can get more destiny in the future. "
Lu Jing extinguished the candle and lay down to rest.
Before falling asleep, for some reason, he suddenly thought of his original wife.
"Nan Heyu..."
Nan Heyu, the prodigy of swordsmanship, studied under Luo Mingyue, the great master of swordsmanship on Yuxing Island, and is one of the most proud men of heaven in Taixuanjing today.
She was born into a distinguished family and was the direct grandson of Duke Dafu Nan. She was the most favored by Duke Nan. In the past two or three years, the elderly Duke Nan had repeatedly proposed to call Nan Heyu back to the capital to become the successor of the title.
It's just that Nan Heyu didn't care about inheriting the title and refused many times.
Later, it happened that Duke Nan Guo was seriously ill and needed Nan Heyu to get married.
And Lu Jing is Nan Heyu's marriage partner.
But after Nan Heyu returned to Beijing, things changed slightly.
The Duke of Nanguo seemed to have regretted his decision.
"Qingyue also thought that we could leave the indifferent Lu Mansion. It's a pity that she was disappointed."
